title: Performance Marketing Working Student – Talent Acquisition
announcement: Performance Marketing Working Student – Talent Acquisition  Location: Berlin Employment type: Working student, 20 hours/week Take a look at where you'll be based: watch the Berlin office tour Team description Talent Acquisition's Performance Marketing function helps attract the right candidates efficiently across different markets and roles. As we continue to strengthen our in-house capabilities, you'll support day-to-day campaign operations, reporting and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with teams across Talent Acquisition and Employer branding, gaining hands-on experience in how data, digital marketing and operational processes support hiring at scale. What you'll do Support the day-to-day monitoring of paid recruitment marketing campaigns and flag anything that needs attention Keep job listings live, accurate and correctly categorised across active boards Support weekly performance reporting across impressions, clicks, applications, cost per application and candidate pipeline contribution, and flag unusual performance or budget pacing. Coordinate creative feedback between the TA team, Employer Brand and external agencies Research markets, audiences and competitors to help sharpen the marketing approach Help improve recurring workflows and identify opportunities to make processes more efficient and support recurring operational tasks across the team You'll be great for this role if… Currently studying Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, Data Analytics or a related field Some hands-on exposure to marketing, recruitment, creative content or communications  Strong written and verbal communication skills in English Comfortable working with spreadsheets and interpreting basic campaign metrics You're detail-oriented, organised and comfortable taking ownership of recurring tasks Interested in digital marketing, data and how processes can be improved Why you should join SumUp 🎉 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office at Ostbahnhof 🌈 Be part of an inclusive and collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued 🏖️ 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days, pro-rated 🚵🏾‍♂️ Access health and well-being support through our Employee Assistance Programme, an Urban Sports Club subsidy, and fitness activities, including on-site gym access, yoga sessions, and team sports 🚆 Benefit from subsidised public transport with the Deutschlandticket, offering unlimited travel on local and regional transport across Germany 🥗 Enjoy partially subsidised office lunches and weekly breakfast 🔗 Receive additional rewards through our employee referral programme when referring talents to join our team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters.
